Title: Improvements for interactions in Azure preview portal

Body.Content:
The following list itemizes improvements for interactions in the Azure preview portal in April 2015:
  • New keyboard shortcuts
  • Recover tiles from error state
  • Customize your monitoring charts
  • Easily copy text from the Essentials panel
  • Quick access to Help and support
  • Simplifications to customize mode
For more information, see Announcing Azure Preview Portal Improvements (April Update). Here are improvements that were made for portal interactions in February 2015:
  • Keyboard shortcuts
  • New (and simpler) startup experience
  • Added Minimize command to all blades
  • Improvements in Browse
  • Maximized blades only scroll vertically
  • Simpler default startboard
  • New setting: disable animations
  • Show value of chart in X axis on hover
  • More resources implementing the Essentials pattern
  • Audit logs
For more information, see Announcing Azure Preview Portal Improvements (February Update). Here are improvements that were made for portal interactions in January 2015:
  • Improve how blades with tiles (or “parts”) display when maximized
  • Make all grid columns resizable
  • Show subscription name when you browse resources
For more information, see Announcing Azure Preview Portal Improvements (January Update).
